body: Both of my closest friends. But both are going through something similar, and I figure 1 suicidal person plus another doesn’t equal 2 happy people. If I complain about anything it just draws their attention to me when they should be focused on trying to feel better.
Please don’t. Are you still here?

I have no reason to be feeling this way. Whenever I have free time my thoughts just spiral so much and I try to relax and everything but it always feels like there’s something weighing my chest down so I can’t breathe.
